minimum.justification: Current DS-050 provides adequate cross-section for linear/tree models

target.justification: Diversified across sectors, market caps, and styles to reduce correlation and improve generalization
target.requirements: Must include small/mid-cap, sector-diversified, delisted-inclusive universe

ideal.justification: Broad US equity coverage with sufficient diversity for sequence model cross-sectional attention
ideal.requirements: Historically valid universe with delistings, sector changes, and market-cap evolution

sector_diversity_requirement: At least 8 GICS sectors represented with >= 10 symbols each in target universe
market_cap_diversity_requirement: Include mega, large, mid, and small-cap to avoid pure correlation cluster
